name: mcp-gee-sweet
description: MCP server for Google Workspace — Sheets, Drive, Docs (HTML or Markdown), Calendar, and Gmail.

credentials_path.title: OAuth client file
credentials_path.description: The OAuth Client ID JSON (Desktop app) downloaded from Google Cloud Console. See docs/auth.md.

enabled_tools.title: Enabled tools
enabled_tools.description: Comma-separated tool names and tool groups to register. Groups: default, all, sheets, drive, docs, calendar, gmail, cache, local-files, comments. Empty loads `default`. Enter `default,local-files` to also create Docs from local Markdown files and upload, download or sync local folders, or `all` for every tool.
